notes.subject: נבלת
notes.rationale: nongoya (folly) laseli kɔnɔ — 'wilted/fallen away' versus 'played the fool'; KJV 'done foolishly'

notes.subject: בהתנשא
notes.rationale: infinitive construct 'in lifting yourself' rendered as manner phrase 'in self-exaltation'

notes.subject: kalanbaga
notes.rationale: verse addresses the reader directly with second-person verbs and a command

notes.subject: i bolo bila i da kan
notes.rationale: imperative summons: put your hand on your mouth

notes.subject: לפה
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no pronoun on 'mouth'; Bambara needs ⟨i⟩ to show whose mouth

translation: Ni i y'i yɛrɛ laseli kɔnɔ n'a fɔ i ye nongoya kɛ, walima ni i ye ko jugu miiri, i bolo bila ⟨i⟩ da kan.
